task.title: Create a new project in a chosen folder from the desktop app
task.description:
The desktop app's one addition beyond a sidebar: making a Workbook project without the CLI.

The import view gains a second action beside scanning: choose a folder, name the project and its key, and the app runs `git init` when the folder is not already a repository and then `workbook setup --key <KEY> --no-sync`, adds the project to the registry, and opens its board.

- The key rules are Workbook's own (`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$`, from `internal/core/id.go`), already enforced by `desktop/src/main/discovery.js` for import, and the wizard's warning that a key cannot be renamed applies unchanged.
- `--no-sync` for the same reason import uses it: adding a project must not push anything. Sync is a per-project choice the user makes afterwards, from the board.
- A folder that already has a Workbook identity is imported, not set up again; only a repository with no identity is bootstrapped. Same rule as import.
- The folder picker is the existing `discovery:pickFolder` dialog.

Depends on the move.
